messages:
maria: Heads up — PR up for Aurora enterprise VPC overrides. Needs review before EOD to hit their maintenance window. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-deploy/pull/683
jon: On it, pinging infra reviewers. Is this only a VPC route table change or are there pod-level tweaks too?
maria: Mostly route table + kube Service annotation to mark internal LB. Also a tiny change to customer secrets mount path (fixes case where KMS key alias differs).
sam: I can take the KMS bits. @leah can you look at the k8s manifest/annotation?
leah: Taking a look now. Quick q: did we run the migration job in staging? Any helm chart bump?
maria: Staging migration ran clean, no blocker. Chart version bumped from 1.22.3 -> 1.22.4 and I noted the diff in the PR description.
jon: Left one comment re: hardcoded CIDR in terraform — prefer var + comment. Added suggestion.
maria: Thanks — applied suggestion and pushed. Triggering CI again.
ci-bot: ci-bot: All checks queued...
ci-bot: ci-bot: All checks passed for private-deploy#683 (unit, fmt, e2e-staging). ✅
sam: KMS policy looks good. One nit: audit log role arn should be customer-scoped; updated the policy in the branch.
leah: LGTM after that tiny docs tweak. @jon can you give final approval? Need someone with infra:write for private configs to merge.
jon: Approving now. Will wait 5m to let any flakey CI finish then merge. :shipit:
maria: Thanks all — scheduling deploy to aurora region at 22:00 UTC. I'll ping Aurora ops and update the runbook.
leah: Can you drop the helm upgrade command here once merged?
maria: Yep — will post after merge.
sam: Follow-up: opened issue to add unit test for prefix handling in mount path, linking to PR.
maria: Great, thanks.
jon: Merged. Deploy queued by deploy-bot.
ci-bot: ci-bot: Deploy to aurora-region queued (release/private-deploy@1.22.4).
maria: Noted — closing thread, thank you team :raised_hands:
